SUMMARY

Technical Lead | SharePoint & Power Platform Expert | 15+ Years of Experience

Power Platform || Canvas Apps || Model Driven Apps || Copilot Studio || Power Pages || Power BI || Power Automate || Power Automate Desktop || SharePoint Online/2019 || SP Migration || Nintex || APIs || SPFx || JavaScript || Typescript || HTML || Data Verse || AI Builder

Technical Lead with over 15 years of expertise in SharePoint, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Data verse, Teams, SPFx, Nintex, and SharePoint migration across multiple versions (Online/2019/2013/2010).

Currently leading Power Platform projects, focusing on solution design and development of Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Power Pages, Power BI, Copilot Studio, Process Automation, and SharePoint migration & development.

Strong background in team leadership, project delivery, and client engagement across diverse geographical locations.

EXPERIENCE

11/2021 - Present

Pune, India

Technical Lead Power Platform | Tech Mahindra Project: DTB PowerApps – Car Scheduling Application (Canvas App on SharePoint)



• •

•

Designed and developed a Canvas App leveraging SharePoint lists as the backend for customer car scheduling.Implemented role-based accs. Designed and developed a Canvas App leveraging SharePoint lists as the backend for customer car scheduling. Implemented role-based access with tailored screens for users and administrators. Automated reminders, approvals, and notifications using Power Automate, integrating with Teams and Outlook for seamless meeting scheduling. Power BI Dashboard deployed into Sharepoint Site displaying the Vehicle Booking Insights. Received Client Recognition Award for successful delivery and adoption of the solution.

Create an Account

01/2013 - 11/2021

Pune, India

Project: Atkins Migrations – SharePoint & Nintex to Power Platform Migration

• • • •

Led migration of SharePoint 2013 sites to SharePoint Online, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity. Redeveloped Nintex forms into modern Canvas Apps with enhanced usability and performance. Converted Nintex and SharePoint Designer workflows into Power Automate flows using best practices. Power BI Dashboard created for reporting and analytics using Power BI Desktop Tool and deployed to Sharepoint Sites. Acted as a Power Platform Consultant, driving adoption and ensuring adherence to governance and compliance standards.

Project: Multi-Cultural Banking – Power Pages, Model-Driven App, Dataverse

• • • • • •

Developed a Power Pages site enabling students to register for banking account creation. Implemented security roles and access control for different categories of users to ensure secure and role-based access. Utilized Dataverse custom tables along with out-of-the-box tables for designing and managing dynamic forms. Built a Model-Driven Application to support internal staff in reviewing and processing applications. Automated processes using Power Automate flows for: Sending acknowledgements to applicants. Routing applications to relevant departments for approval and processing.

Senior Software Engineer, SharePoint | Emerson Export Engineering Centre Project: I Expense PowerApps: Canvas App, SharePoint







•

Designed and implemented a Canvas App built on SharePoint Lists to enable finance teams and end-users to easily capture, upload, and submit expense receipts and reports via mobile devices. Integrated the app with Power Automate to streamline workflows, automate notifications, and manage user permissions. Automated user access and permissions management using Power Automate flows, ensuring secure and efficient governance. Developed and scheduled PowerApps usage tracking by logging reports into Excel through automated workflows. Performed end-to-end testing, deployment, and post-deployment support, resolving technical challenges and assisting end-users for smooth adoption.

Project: GE Migration – Intranet Portal









Collaborated with the team to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring alignment with business specifications including Analytics and Risk. Migrated and re-created business processes from SharePoint Designer to Power Automate, maintaining process integrity and efficiency. Creating Canvas App in place of Infopath forms and Developing the custom third party charts into Power BI for Sharepoint Online. Monitored and resolved runtime issues to ensure smooth execution and timely project completion within a restricted time window.

EXPERIENCE

12/2011 - 12/2012

Pune, India

10/2010 - 12/2011

Pune, India

11/2009 - 10/2010

Pune, India

EDUCATION

2004

Project: CAR Application – Intranet Portal





Developed an intranet portal serving as a centralized platform for document management, web content management, and corrective action tracking. The solution enabled Business and Sales Teams to efficiently respond to user-reported queries and issues, ensuring timely resolution and improved collaboration.

Software Developer – SharePoint | Cube 9 Global Services Project: Asset Management Portal (SharePoint 2010)

•

• •

Developed a SharePoint 2010 portal enabling users to track organizational assets. Developed and customized SharePoint features including Custom Pages, Web Parts, Timer Jobs, and Designer Workflows. Implemented SharePoint Out-of-the-box features to streamline portal functionality. Designed and configured permission-based access control for secure and role-specific views. Enhanced portal usability and reporting through customized UI and workflow automation.

Junior Software Developer | Juventus Technologies Pvt. Ltd Project: PARC Management (SharePoint 2010)



• •

Developed custom solutions on SharePoint 2010 (client and server-side), including workflows, list templates, and site templates. Managed permissions, content types, and site creation using SharePoint Designer and Central Administration. Designed and implemented Visual Studio workflows to streamline business processes. Contributed to building reusable components for faster site re-creation and deployment.

.NET Developer | R S Technology & Solutions Project: Kiingsz Masala Website (ASP.Net and SQL Server)

• •



Analyzed business requirements and translated them into technical specifications and conceptual designs. Designed and developed web component modules using ASP.NET and C#. Built and optimized database objects, including tables, triggers, stored procedures, and views, to improve performance and functionality. Enhanced website functionality and improved user experience through efficient coding and modular development practices.

Higher School Certificate Maharashtra Board

2009

Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Pune University

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS



Pat on the Back award for Multi Cultural Banking App/Site

Contributed to innovation solutions and completed deployment of App Successfully with quality.



Innovation Award – Database Extraction and Comparison Application Issued by Emerson Export Engineering Centre, Pune · Sep 2016

Recognized for developing a Database Extraction and Comparison Application that automated the process of creating and comparing data across multiple Excel files.

Impact: Eliminated significant manual effort, reduced execution time drastically, and accelerated overall report generation.

Value Delivered: Improved efficiency, accuracy, and cost savings for the organization.



Pat on the Back award for DTB Scheduling App

Very nice looking App with easy to use for customers.

Designed and developed a Canvas App leveraging SharePoint lists as the backend for customer car scheduling. Implemented role-based access with tailored screens for users and administrators. Automated reminders, approvals, and notifications using Power Automate, integrating with Teams and Outlook for seamless meeting scheduling. Power BI Dashboard deployed into Sharepoint Site displaying the Vehicle Booking Insights. Received Client Recognition Award for successful delivery and adoption of the solution.

Pune, India
Project: Atkins Migrations – SharePoint & Nintex to Power Platform Migration
• • • •
Led migration of SharePoint 2013 sites to SharePoint Online, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity. Redeveloped Nintex forms into modern Canvas Apps with enhanced usability and performance. Converted Nintex and SharePoint Designer workflows into Power Automate flows using best practices. Power BI Dashboard created for reporting and analytics using Power BI Desktop Tool and deployed to Sharepoint Sites. Acted as a Power Platform Consultant, driving adoption and ensuring adherence to governance and compliance standards.
Project: Multi-Cultural Banking – Power Pages, Model-Driven App, Dataverse
• • • • • •
Developed a Power Pages site enabling students to register for banking account creation. Implemented security roles and access control for different categories of users to ensure secure and role-based access. Utilized Dataverse custom tables along with out-of-the-box tables for designing and managing dynamic forms. Built a Model-Driven Application to support internal staff in reviewing and processing applications. Automated processes using Power Automate flows for: Sending acknowledgements to applicants. Routing applications to relevant departments for approval and processing.
Senior Software Engineer, SharePoint | Emerson Export Engineering Centre Project: I Expense PowerApps: Canvas App, SharePoint



•
Designed and implemented a Canvas App built on SharePoint Lists to enable finance teams and end-users to easily capture, upload, and submit expense receipts and reports via mobile devices. Integrated the app with Power Automate to streamline workflows, automate notifications, and manage user permissions. Automated user access and permissions management using Power Automate flows, ensuring secure and efficient governance. Developed and scheduled PowerApps usage tracking by logging reports into Excel through automated workflows. Performed end-to-end testing, deployment, and post-deployment support, resolving technical challenges and assisting end-users for smooth adoption.
Project: GE Migration – Intranet Portal




Collaborated with the team to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring alignment with business specifications including Analytics and Risk. Migrated and re-created business processes from SharePoint Designer to Power Automate, maintaining process integrity and efficiency. Creating Canvas App in place of Infopath forms and Developing the custom third party charts into Power BI for Sharepoint Online. Monitored and resolved runtime issues to ensure smooth execution and timely project completion within a restricted time window.
